canvas-white.$description: Canvas White — Page background, sidebar background, card surfaces, input fills

youtube-ink.$description: YouTube Ink — Primary text, icon strokes, logo wordmark, button text — the near-black that defines the entire interface

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, metadata, timestamps, muted descriptions, nav secondary labels

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary text, disabled states, inactive icon strokes, micro-copy

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline borders, inactive toggle tracks, subtle dividers

silver.$description: Silver — Button borders, input field outlines, card outlines — the structural divider

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

play-red.$description: Play Red — Logo play triangle exclusively — the locked brand mark, never used as a functional UI color

roboto.$description: Primary interface font — nav labels, body copy, links, button text, metadata, timestamps. The 2.57 line-height on small sizes creates generous vertical breathing room for sidebar items.

youtube-sans.$description: Wordmark only — the logo's custom typeface that makes 'YouTube' instantly recognizable. Never used for headings, body, or nav.

arial.$description: System fallback for legacy components and button labels in older UI fragments
